scope: Issue 176 client identity. A foreground lane router on port 18797 ran this code against the real accounts, with copies of the dobby and work logins (lane.py, lane-config.json), on Linux 7.0 x86_64. Its SDK config set upstream.claude.disable-claude-cloak-mode (sdk-config-upstream.txt). As a control, the daily router, installed at ec1ea5d before the fix, refused a t3-code request for claude-fable-5-2 with the 2.1.280 error. Through the lane, real claude -p requests for claude-fable-5-2 were answered as a t3-code client for a new conversation, a resume, and a resume after a manual move to the other account, as an sdk-ts client, and with Claude Code's default entrypoint. Each resume answered with the word from the first turn. The lane cannot show the User-Agent or body the provider received, so the provider's acceptance of claude-fable-5-2, which needs Claude Code 2.1.290 or newer, stands in for it. TestT3AndAgentSDKRequestsReachTheUpstreamWithTheClientsUserAgentAndBody covers the headers and body offline, including after an exhaustion move. record.py built the record. Unchanged historical scenarios are references and were not rerun.
